title: helianthus occidentalis var. dowellianus
intro: Helianthus occidentalis var. dowellianus, commonly known as Western Sunflower, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents present in Helianthus occidentalis var. dowellianus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its various health benefits and therapeutic uses.
